title: On Ignoring the notice on the gate
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：ignore　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ignore 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the gardener ① ignored the notice on the gate year after year, and every apprentice in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the gardener ② ignores the notice on the gate for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ ignore the notice on the gate at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ ignored the notice on the gate before — a line in the notebook for April 1956 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Ignoring the notice on the gate year after year, the gardener said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ ignore what everybody else said for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Ignore what everybody else said at once and never mention it again.

By 1969 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new apprentice from the next garden ⑧ ignores what everybody else said year after year every spring without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ ignored the notice on the gate again when nobody else would.

⑩ To ignore the notice on the gate, my mother said in 1974, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody ignores the notice on the gate for the whole place again and somebody must ignore the notice on the gate year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 不理会（一般过去式 ignored the notice on the gate：1962 年园丁头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 不理会（一般现在 ignores the notice on the gate：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 不理会（不定式 to ignore the notice on the gate：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 不理会（过去完成时 had ignored the notice on the gate：1956 年四月的园艺笔记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 不理会（动名词 ignoring the notice on the gate 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 不顾（ignore what everybody else said：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去不顾把别人说的全顾不上）
G. v. 不顾（ignore what everybody else said：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 不理会（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 ignores what everybody else said，而母亲又一次 ignored the notice on the gate）

answers.why: ignore 意为“不理会”，1962 年园丁年年地不理会不理会门口那张告示，那是园子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 ignored。
ignore 意为“不理会”，自那以后园丁替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 ignores。
ignore 意为“不理会”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯不理会不理会门口那张告示”，此处为不定式 to ignore the notice on the gate。
ignore 意为“不理会”，园艺笔记里 四月 那行字说明早在 1969 年之前就有人不理会过，故用过去完成时 had ignored。
ignore 意为“不理会”，园丁说“不理会不理会门口那张告示这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 ignoring the notice on the gate 作主语。
ignore 意为“不顾”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去不顾把别人说的全顾不上”，should ever 之后用原形 ignore what everybody else said。
ignore 意为“不顾”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻不顾把别人说的全顾不上（ignore what everybody else said at once），以后再也不要提起。
ignore 意为“不理会”，新来的学徒每个春天都照例不顾把别人说的全顾不上，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 ignores。
ignore 意为“不理会”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地不理会不理会门口那张告示，用一般过去式 ignored 叙述。
ignore 意为“不理会”，结尾那句是母亲 1974 年的话：要不理会不理会门口那张告示，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和园子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ignore 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the gardener ignored the notice on the gate year after year, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the gardener ignores the notice on the gate for the whole place whenever the garden asks.
Ignoring the notice on the gate year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever ignore what everybody else said for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next garden ignores what everybody else said year after year every spring, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother ignored the notice on the gate again, and the garden remembered that half.
